researchNotes: Current September 2026 EIA-860M workbook was downloaded and read, released October 23. Relevant capacity/status/month/coordinates match the prior August snapshot. September workbook is cited directly; published month is not an exact COD. NYPA project-specific 2029 Rich Road timeline supersedes older inventory forecast, already saved on canonical 16599.

Sixteen unsupported tracker prices were cleared. No unambiguous matched construction budget was verified for these corrected scopes. PJM network upgrades, portfolio/campus totals, financing, lease revenue, tax benefits, decommissioning obligations and unrelated projects are not substituted. Rich Road FAQ’s $400M is rejected because the same page mixes Ridge View/Niagara/Hartland/Newfane geography and unrelated storage scope; duplicate 17065 is held, canonical 16599 retained.

Nine original marker corrections were prepared; Rich Road was subsequently found to duplicate canonical 16599. Eight live pins received 16 replacement maps; its two extra uploaded maps remain unused. Five Alliant gallery photographs show the combined Pleasant Creek property/construction, not independently identified Phase I. Issuer/factsheet pages are proposed or campus-level evidence, not as-built images. The Obsidian factsheet explicitly labels the Black Cap photograph as a different illustrative facility.

Plain curl verified all seven gallery original downloads; source PDF pages were rendered to JPEG and credited. Current public Azure files were checked, including original bytes for new uploads. No pin image was added to Git.

The API derives companyWikiUrl from a linked company when an explicit pin-level URL is null. Verification checks the company identity and internal company wiki readback; it does not require that derived display URL to remain null or claim fresh independent research of every corporate fact.

MISO and ISO shared source-wiki coverage was preserved and selected current rows appended. Source-index reconciliation is guarded against concurrent pin content changes and audited. Earlier pins sharing refreshed source wikis are verified unchanged. All current corrected-pin citations and internal company wikis are read back; inaccessible held-identity sources remain research gaps, not placeholder live wikis.

Exact USACE York County DC2 plan returns 403 in direct, web-reader and alternate-path attempts despite a search-indexed labelled plan. CloudHQ village reports and latest Obsidian signed amendment exact URL return 404. NYPA HTTPS page was opened substantively in web retrieval while direct TLS verification fails. Original CME download is blocked but substantive page was opened with web retrieval.
